edits.current: SHARP CONTRAST WITH FORM 350. The instruction guide says this number is 'asignado por la natural person o juridica que expide la certificacion' - the EMPLOYER assigns it, not DIAN. On Form 350 casilla 4 is DIAN-assigned and opaque. The engine must therefore maintain its own certificate numbering series and keep it stable, because the employee quotes it. COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown. Because DIAN prescribes NO structure, the series is Mercans-designed and is fixed here so that it is stable and auditable: positions 1-4 = accrual year AAAA, source PayPeriod.Fiscal_Year, the year the income was earned and NOT the year of issue; position 5 = literal hyphen; positions 6-11 = a six-digit zero-filled consecutive, source Mercans.Certificate_Sequence, restarting at 000001 for each accrual year and unique per employer per year. PERSISTENCE: assigned once and NEVER reused, including after a reissue - a replacement certificate takes the NEXT consecutive and cites the superseded number, because ET art. 378 makes the employee's copy the document that proves the withholding and two certificates may not share a number.

edits.current: The instruction guide prints a SIX-VALUE list on the form itself: 12 Minor ID card, 13 Citizenship ID card, 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Foreign resident ID card, 31 NIT, 41 Passport. That is NARROWER than the electronic payroll list at Annex table 5.2.1, which also carries 11 Record civil, 42 Foreign identity document, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais and 91 NUIP. An employee holding a PEP or a PPT therefore has NO exact code here. Rule to be set at implementation: the code to output for a PEP or PPT holder. SOURCE: the employee master holds one document-number field per document type ('National ID', 'Identity Card', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'Citizenship Card ID') and no document-type field, and more than one of them may be populated for the same employee. The engine must store an explicit Employee.Document_Type for the document actually certified in casilla 25, never infer it from which field is filled. The mapping of the employee master document fields to the Form 220 codes is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation (e.g. 'Citizenship Card ID' -> 13 and 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> 22; 'National ID' and 'Identity Card' have no direct Form 220 code).

edits.current: City or municipality where the withholding was practised - not necessarily the employer's registered domicile, and not necessarily the employee's place of work. It is a withholding-agent parameter (an employer setting supplied at implementation, held as the five-digit DIVIPOLA code of the place of withholding), not an employee attribute. Output the municipality NAME, in upper case without accents, that corresponds to the DANE code of casillas 34 and 35, so that the three casillas always describe the same place.

edits.current: DANE department code of the place in casilla 33: the FIRST TWO digits of the five-digit DIVIPOLA municipality code. The instruction guide directs the use of the DANE 'Department codes' tables. Hold the five-digit DIVIPOLA code of the place of withholding once (e.g. 11001 Bogota D.C.) and split it - casilla 34 = the first two digits ('11'), casilla 35 = the last three ('001') - never output five digits in either casilla.

edits.current: Total salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period to a resident natural person whose income derives from an employment or statutory relationship. The instruction guide quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. SOURCE: salary wage types 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. The wage-type attribute 'Salary Payment Indicator' must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus) and on per diems (62805-62808), which belong to casillas 42 and 43, and on the leave payouts 79405-79419 (marriage, maternity, paternity, sick-leave, bereavement, paid and jury leave payouts); and it is absent from other bonuses (e.g. 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus, 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up). The engine holds an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table, a configuration parameter supplied at implementation; every earning wage type is assigned. Rule to be set at implementation: the casilla of the leave payouts 79405-79419 and of salary paid abroad to expatriates (25830 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country). PERIOD: sum the payments made from 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.
edits.proposed: Total salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period to a resident natural person whose income derives from an employment or statutory relationship. The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. SOURCE: salary wage types 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. BONUSES: HABITUAL bonuses are salary and are certified here - 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus and 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA; NON-HABITUAL bonuses are certified in casilla 46 - 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA is routed by the habitual / non-habitual flag held on the wage-type-to-casilla table (casilla 36 where habitual, casilla 46 where not). The wage-type attribute 'Salary Payment Indicator' must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus), which is certified in casilla 42, and on per diems (62805-62808), which are always certified in casilla 43, and on the leave payouts 79405-79419 (marriage, maternity, paternity, sick-leave, bereavement, paid and jury leave payouts); and it is absent from the bonus wage types 62229, 62224 and 62202 listed above. The engine holds an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table, a configuration parameter supplied at implementation; every earning wage type is assigned. Rule to be set at implementation: the casilla of the leave payouts 79405-79419 and of salary paid abroad to expatriates (25830 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country). PERIOD: sum the payments made from 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.

edits.current: Payments made in electronic or paper service vouchers, cheques, cards or vales - for fuel, school supplies, footwear and clothing, or any other purpose. Deductible for the employer and income for the employee. THREE EXPLICIT NOTES in the instruction guide: (1) INCLUDE meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month; (2) do NOT include meal payments for an employee earning up to 310 UVT - those go to casilla 38; (3) do NOT include anything already reported in casilla 36. SOURCE: in-kind benefits paid to third parties are booked as informative earning wage types ('Inf.') offset by an equal informative deduction - e.g. 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079 offset by 21115 Meal Allowance Inf. Deduction-2644 - and the same pattern applies to 65811 Gym Allowance Inf.-6969, 65809 / 65839 Optical Allowance Inf, 65812 Text Books Allowance - Inf-6971, 65801 / 65814 / 65815 / 65831 Private Health Insurance Inf and 65817 / 65837 Life Insurance-Inf. The earning side is the certified value; the offsetting deduction wage types are payroll mechanics and are not themselves casilla values. The meal item 65818 is subject to the 41 UVT / 310 UVT test of casillas 37-38. Rule to be set at implementation: the casilla (37, 38, 46 or none) of each of the other in-kind benefit wage types listed above, in the wage-type-to-casilla table.

Rule to be set at implementation: the casilla (37, 38, 46 or none) of each of the other in-kind benefit wage types listed above, in the wage-type-to-casilla table.

The engine holds an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table (a configuration parameter supplied at implementation); no earning wage type may be left unassigned. Rule to be set at implementation: the casilla (36, 42, 46 or not certified) of the earning wage types with no dedicated casilla: 62131 Scholarship-6861, 62700 School Allowance-6839, 62590 Marriage Allowance-6801, 62591 Child Birth Allowance-6002, 62112 Family Burial Allowance-6319, 62811 Health Allowance-6473, 62523 Transportation Allowance CLA- 2008, 62540 Housing Allowance Domestic Relocation-2087, 62310 Expat allowance 5526, 62320 Leasing Expat Allowance Inf-5524, 65821 Expatriation Package for Inbounds, 65800 Stock awards (Vesting) - Informative-1004, 62138 Dividend payment (stock awards) -1003, 65803 Plan Institucional PROTECCION - Payment- 6785, 65804 Plan Institucional PROTECCION - IC Bonus, 62180 / 62181 Severance/Layoff Payment (dismissal indemnity) and 62837 Leave payout. Pension income paid directly by the employer is certified in casilla 50, never here (see casilla 50).

edits.current: THE THIRD OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. The amount DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen severance fund by 14 February for the balance at the preceding 31 December, under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99. The engine must maintain all three buckets - paid to the employee, traditional regime, deposited to the fund - separately from the outset; they cannot be split retrospectively out of a single cesantias figure. SOURCE: wage type 25827 Payment Severance Funds Inf. (mirrored by 65805 with the same amount - take one, not both), paid in February. Rule to be set at implementation: the tax year in which a February deposit (for the balance at the preceding 31 December) is certified. The provision wage types 22110 / 42110 are accruals, not the deposit.
edits.proposed: THE THIRD OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen severance fund IN THE TAX YEAR, under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99. The deposit made by 14 February for the balance at the preceding 31 December belongs to the tax year in which it is deposited, not to the year of accrual: severance income is realised on deposit to the fund (ET art. 27 num. 3; instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). The certificate for tax year N therefore carries the deposit made by 14 February of year N (balance at 31 December of year N-1); the deposit made by 14 February of year N+1 belongs to the certificate for year N+1. The engine must maintain all three buckets - paid to the employee, traditional regime, deposited to the fund - separately from the outset; they cannot be split retrospectively out of a single cesantias figure. SOURCE: wage type 25827 Payment Severance Funds Inf. (mirrored by 65805 with the same amount - take one, not both), paid in February and certified in the tax year of that payment. The provision wage types 22110 / 42110 are accruals, not the deposit.

edits.current: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER. Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Pensions paid directly by the employer are in scope and are certified here. SOURCE: the pension wage types of the wage-type-to-casilla table: 62154 Monthly Retired  Pension-6798 (the monthly pension), 62153 Additional Retirement Pension (the additional instalments paid in June and December), 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV-6795, 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya-6796, 62115 Retirement Allowance, 62830 Pensioner Allowance-6794 and 62155 Medical Plan - Healthcare Insurance (EPS ) Pensioner- PMI Offset Compensation. Rule to be set at implementation: which of these wage types are pension income for this casilla and which, if any, belong in casilla 46. Pension payees are not in the employee master: their identification (casillas 24-29) comes from the pensioner identity source configured at implementation (see casilla 25). Rule to be set at implementation: to whom the certificate is issued where the pension is paid to a beneficiary other than the pensioner (substitute pensioner or third-party payee). Pensioner health and solidarity deductions (21645 / 21646 / 21647, 21643) feed casillas 53 and 54, and the withholding on pension income (21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799) feeds casilla 60.
edits.proposed: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER: pensions of jubilacion, vejez or invalidez (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Pensions paid directly by the employer are in scope and are certified here. SOURCE: the pension wage types of the wage-type-to-casilla table: 62154 Monthly Retired  Pension-6798 (the monthly pension) and 62153 Additional Retirement Pension (the additional pension instalments paid in June and December). Payments to retirees that are not a pension are certified in casilla 46, never here: 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV-6795, 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya-6796, 62115 Retirement Allowance, 62830 Pensioner Allowance-6794 and 62155 Medical Plan - Healthcare Insurance (EPS ) Pensioner- PMI Offset Compensation (see casilla 46). Pension payees are not in the employee master: their identification (casillas 24-29) comes from the pensioner identity source configured at implementation (see casilla 25). Rule to be set at implementation: to whom the certificate is issued where the pension is paid to a beneficiary other than the pensioner (substitute pensioner or third-party payee). Pensioner health and solidarity deductions (21645 / 21646 / 21647, 21643) feed casillas 53 and 54, and the withholding on pension income (21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799) feeds casilla 60.

edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING CASILLA. Total withholding at source practised on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period. Feeds casilla 75 together with casilla 74. Must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 for this employee, and the sum of casilla 60 across all employees must reconcile to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93 - allowing for the rounding conventions. SOURCE: the withholding practised is wage type 2552 Income Tax (employee) plus 21129 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations- 541T (a separate deduction on termination payments, which can coexist with 2552 in the same month) and 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799. Wage types 21330 Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical) and 25834 Hypothetical Witholding Tax  - IC Foreign Country are notional and are NOT certified. Rule to be set at implementation: whether 25832 / 65832 Witholding Tax on Stock awards and 25833 Witholding Tax  - IC Local Country are certified here. Only the withholding actually deducted is certified: a comparison result computed without the contribution depuration, and any contingent withholding derived from it, is not part of 2552 and is not certified. Sum January to December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.
edits.proposed: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING CASILLA. Total withholding at source ACTUALLY PRACTISED on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period; no hypothetical, theoretical or contingent amount is certified (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). Feeds casilla 75 together with casilla 74. Must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 for this employee, and the sum of casilla 60 across all employees must reconcile to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93 - allowing for the rounding conventions. SOURCE: the withholding practised is wage type 2552 Income Tax (employee) plus 21129 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations- 541T (a separate deduction on termination payments, which can coexist with 2552 in the same month) and 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799. Wage types 21330 Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical) and 25834 Hypothetical Witholding Tax  - IC Foreign Country are notional, not withholding practised, and are NOT certified; the same exclusion applies to every wage type that computes a theoretical, hypothetical or contingent withholding. Rule to be set at implementation: whether 25832 / 65832 Witholding Tax on Stock awards and 25833 Witholding Tax  - IC Local Country carry withholding actually practised on this employee's income and are certified here. Only the withholding actually deducted is certified: a comparison result computed without the contribution depuration, and any contingent withholding derived from it, is not part of 2552 and is not certified. Sum January to December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.

edits.current: The exclusion rule is the trap. Commissions under an employment contract are salary and stay in casilla 36; commissions outside an employment relationship go to casilla 41. Per diems go to casilla 43 even where the permanent portion is salary for contribution purposes. The certificate's classification and the contribution base's classification are NOT the same.
edits.proposed: The exclusion rule is the trap. Commissions under an employment contract are salary and stay in casilla 36; commissions outside an employment relationship go to casilla 41. Habitual bonuses are salary and stay in casilla 36; non-habitual bonuses go to casilla 46. Vacation pay goes to casilla 42. Per diems ALWAYS go to casilla 43, even where the permanent portion is salary for contribution purposes. The certificate's classification and the contribution base's classification are NOT the same.

edits.current: Maintain THREE separate severance buckets from the outset, not one: (47) amounts and interest ACTUALLY PAID to the employee, (48) amounts RECOGNISED under the pre-1991 traditional CST regime, and (49) amounts DEPOSITED to the fund by 14 February. Casillas 48 and 49 are mutually exclusive for the same employee, because an employee is in one regime or the other.

edits.current: Accumulate the retencion en la fuente actually practised on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period. For a RESIDENT this is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Where the employee changed residence status mid-year, sum both.
